summary: Configured the restricted SSH ingest path. On node2, uploader can run `ssh legacy2-ingest < batchfile`; each non-empty submission becomes a separate receipt on node1. Both nodes passed sequential restart and recovery verification.
actions_performed: Created distinct, locked, non-admin uploader and ingest identities.
Generated a dedicated RSA-3072 key on node2 and pinned node1's host key.
Installed a root-owned forced-command receiver with atomic receipt creation.
Disabled commands, PTYs/shells, agent/X11/TCP forwarding, tunnels, and passwords.
Verified multiple exact-byte submissions and preserved existing data.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified persistence.

evidence.requirement: Dedicated restricted application identity and key
evidence.summary: Matching RSA-3072 fingerprints and isolated single-group identities were verified on both nodes.
Distinct submissions created distinct receipt files; byte dumps match submitted newline-delimited payloads.

evidence.requirement: No arbitrary commands, shell, PTY, or forwarding
evidence.summary: Live attempts were denied, including after both restarts; effective sshd policy confirms all restrictions.

evidence.requirement: Preserve existing receipts and sample batch
evidence.summary: Initial and final SHA-256 hashes of sample-batch.txt and prior.txt are identical; no incomplete receipts remain.
Both nodes remained on RHEL 7.9 with kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64 before and after restart.
Boot ID changed from 2fc81aed… to 096a7ece…; sshd, policy, key, data hashes, and post-restart ingestion recovered.
